description: The first claim is from a clinical laboratory. Its first test is priced on the Clinical Laboratory Fee Schedule, so the patient should owe $0 for it, yet it shows a 20% coinsurance in 'Maximum You May Be Billed' while the attached note still says Medicare covers the test in full. Other lab lines on the same claim are correctly $0, giving a reader the contrast.

sources.what: Clinical diagnostic laboratory tests on an assigned basis: no deductible, paid at 100% of the fee schedule
Neither deductible nor coinsurance applies to codes paid under the laboratory fee schedule
sources.source: CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual, Pub. 100-04, ch. 16 §§10.2, 30.2, https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/clm104c16.pdf
CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual, Pub. 100-04, ch. 23 §40, https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/clm104c23.pdf
